page.overview:
Who is Syla Krohn?

Syla Krohn was a host of the Communinet Radio station of House Harkonnen.

Syla Krohn announced to her listeners that she would be their guide and confidant, leading them through gloriuos days under the might of their beloved Baron Vladimir Harkonnen. She then played some music to invigorate her listeners before introducing The Convert.
